0022600172.text: The Lakers (5-2, 1st in the Pacific, 4th in the West) host the Miami Heat (2-4, 10th in the East) in this regular season game, Los Angeles' eighth of the season, with the Lakers on a one-game winning streak and 3-1 at home. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, but the Lakers won both matchups in 2025-26, most recently 134-126 in Miami on March 19, 2026. Adou Thiero (knee inflammation) and Ziaire Williams (foot), who is averaging 11.3 points and 28.4 minutes this season, are out for the Lakers, while Heat guard Tim Hardaway Jr. is day-to-day for personal reasons and is a game-time decision.
